verdict.rationale: Fellow documents natural-language interaction with its data. Its official MCP Server lets users "ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code" from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and the pricing page lists an "Ask Fellow" feature. The evidence only shows natural-language questions and retrieval, though, not natural-language commands that operate the product (e.g. creating notes, completing action items, starting recordings). missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that take actions in Fellow, a described native in-product natural-language interface ("Ask Fellow" is only named), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items
